photos.alt: Comparison photo: 1961 Epiphone Sheraton. Full guitar in its blue-lined case
photos.caption: Comparison: 1961 Epiphone Sheraton. Full guitar in its blue-lined case. Photo from Joe’s archive. This is a 1961 Sheraton, not a Broadway. It shows Kalamazoo Epiphone workmanship, but its double-cutaway center-block body differs from the full-depth hollow Broadway.

photos.alt: Comparison photo: 1961 Epiphone Sheraton. Body with two mini-humbuckers and Bigsby
photos.caption: Comparison: 1961 Epiphone Sheraton. Body with two mini-humbuckers and Bigsby. Photo from Joe’s archive. The Sheraton’s mini-humbuckers illustrate the pickup family; its body and Bigsby are not a Broadway specification.

photos.alt: Comparison photo: 1946 Epiphone Triumph. Non-cutaway archtop with added DeArmond pickup
photos.caption: Comparison: 1946 Epiphone Triumph. Non-cutaway archtop with added DeArmond pickup. Photo from Joe’s archive. This is a Triumph, not a Broadway. Its added pickup illustrates why acoustic construction and electrical accessories are assessed separately.
